reserveReview.rationale: Same-block reads at XDC block 108850925 (hash 0x23b3d757b619dc71c717407c74dc85d0c68d95c1c5d85e1e22f6947e2c788080, 2026-10-29T18:39:13Z) measured 25,407,276.931021211688722203 psXDC, 7,471,325.302964620943948893 WXDC, and 0.06854102440070889 CGO in the three CollateralTokenAdapters returned by CollateralPoolConfig.getAdapter for pool ids psXDC, XDC and CGO; the psXDC and WXDC balances are unchanged from those measured at block 108767954 on 2026-10-27. The protocol's FathomPriceOracle returned $0.0330416 for XDC (updated 2026-10-29T18:36:40Z) and $128.713 for CGO (updated 2026-10-29T18:35:25Z) at the same block, and the psXDC pool has no separate psXDC/XDC rate, so it remains protocol-priced one-for-one as XDC. Applying that valuation produced collateral values of $839,497.08, $246,864.54 and $8.82, or 77.275%, 22.724% and 0.001% of $1,086,370.45 gross collateral after rounding. The lower XDC price reduces absolute collateral value but not the measured shares. The earlier exhaustive LogInitCollateralPoolId scan remains the pool-inventory evidence; this read resolves the same three pools.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Same-block on-chain CollateralTokenAdapter balances and protocol oracle prices at XDC block 108850925
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Pool identities, balances, and protocol valuation weights are measured at XDC block 108850925. Weights can change after that block, and psXDC retains Fathom's one-for-one XDC valuation because the protocol has no separate psXDC exchange-rate feed.
